target.name: Unchanged Steam Prey / PreyVR player candidate 07, simulator captures

question: Do the historical player-preview PNGs described as missing help text actually lose card glyph pixels at an equivalent layout?
claim: No. 112 eye images have identical help-card pixels within four matched eye/layout/alpha groups. The historical candidate-07 images labelled faulty match the known-complete card byte for byte. Forty-two new captures cover title, inventory, uninstrumented inventory and four menu reopen cycles. The prior missing-text diagnosis was a visual-inspection error; no mod rendering fix was needed.
method: Corrects the missing-card interpretation in 20260910-native-hud-layer and the frozen RE-VR-INTERFACE report. Actual injected Prey PID 121908 using unchanged candidate-07 DLL and private xr-sim. Six title and sixteen inventory captures record D3D CPU state with bounded Frida hooks; sixteen inventory and four reopen captures have no hooks. Pillow check-card-pixels.py hashes exact RGB ROIs from original PNGs, groups by optical/layout metadata and requires the historical positive/negative-labelled controls; empty/missing coverage returns NO_DATA. No GPU readback is used by the new draw-state probe.

identity.reason: Production source matched frozen snapshot before run; loaded DLL hash 7e38452274fc570b0adfaa67db46c0c2417755356c38f6a5512436fc42f755b0; Steam target gate passed.

instrument.reason: Checks read original PNG pixels and sidecars, not interpreted previews. Exact known-complete crop is visible; hashes and all compared artifacts are preserved.

control.reason: Historically labelled missing images equal the complete reference. New uninstrumented captures and reopen cycles match too; moved-head layouts excluded.

scene.reason: Actual Prey title, existing Talos Lobby save and inventory under explicitly simulated headset/controller profile.

restore.reason: All probes detached; owned process disarmed and closed normally; no fleet game overlapped, native crash-log timestamp unchanged, shared runtime and game binaries unchanged.

baseline.reason: Bounded pixel comparison passes for 112 eye images; unchanged implementation retains prior 33/33 CTest result. This is not an all-runtime/all-feature production or headset approval.

limits: Refutes only the claimed card loss in the preserved capture population. No physical Quest/VDXR comfort/readability test, every-weapon/terminal acceptance or performance guarantee. Earlier capped traces, native-versus-optical frustum policy and transitional zero-layer checks remain separately documented.

do_not_repeat.approach: Diagnose missing small text from an interpreted full-frame preview without checking the saved pixels.
do_not_repeat.reason: The historical images labelled faulty contained identical complete glyph pixels.
do_not_repeat.reopen_when: An equivalent-layout saved capture or headset observation demonstrates actual pixel/glyph loss.
